name: Sir Halvern
greeting: Do not close it. There are still people on the road.
lines: Halvern: Sanctuary under the Vargan seal. Those were the words. They came because of the words.
Kael: What happened after you refused?
Halvern: Rope. The yard. Dawn. Do not close it.
Kael: You cannot tell me about Edric. Your memory ends here.
Kael: I was ordered to retreat from another road. There were people we had promised to escort. I went.
Kael: I wrote that we could not hold. I left out that I never went back.
Halvern: There are still people on the road.

actions.label: Preserve the refusal as testimony. Do not demand another oath.
actions.result: Kael copies the sanctuary order and refusal. The bounded memory stays with the blade; it cannot consent for a living person.
actions.preview: Kael copies the sanctuary order and refusal. The bounded memory stays with the blade; it cannot consent for a living person.
actions.cost: Copies preserve the refusal, not every memory the fragment carries.

actions.label: Record the refusal, then release the exhausted memory.
actions.result: The order and refusal are copied before the fragment settles. Kael keeps his own confession in the same account.
actions.preview: The order and refusal are copied before the fragment settles. Kael keeps his own confession in the same account.

actions.label: Keep the copied order. End the remaining grave binding.
actions.result: The irreplaceable shape is destroyed after its command is recorded. The copied proof remains; its surrounding memories are lost.
actions.preview: The irreplaceable shape is destroyed after its command is recorded. The copied proof remains; its surrounding memories are lost.
